presets.name: Lintelled stone-ring study
presets.summary: A circular arrangement of uprights and connecting lintels makes the post-and-lintel principle visible.
limitations: An invented ring of twelve posts; not a Stonehenge survey, reconstruction, calendar, or account of its full landscape.
Stone textures, construction sequence, interlocking joints, soil and foundations are omitted.

presets.name: Egyptian stepped-massing study
presets.summary: Six diminishing square tiers isolate the massing idea of a stepped pyramid.
limitations: Invented proportions; not Djoser's complex or any measured archaeological monument.
Internal chambers, masonry bonding, surrounding funerary complex and construction history are omitted.

presets.name: Egyptian smooth-pyramid study
presets.summary: Four planar faces and a square base contrast smooth-sided massing with the stepped study.
limitations: Invented slope and size; not a reconstruction of a Giza pyramid.
A single closed surface represents external massing only; no chamber, casing-joint or construction claims.

presets.name: Maya terrace-and-stair study
presets.summary: Diminishing platforms, a prominent stair and a small summit canopy demonstrate a different spatial sequence from Egyptian pyramid massing.
limitations: An abstract study informed by INAH's Chichen Itza descriptions; not El Castillo or a universal Mesoamerican type.
No sacred iconography, calendrical alignment, authentic stair dimensions, site context or archaeological reconstruction is claimed.

presets.name: Classical colonnade study
presets.summary: Two rows of tapered columns support simplified capitals and a layered entablature.
limitations: A comparative structural diagram, not a complete Doric, Ionic or Corinthian order.
Fluting, entasis, polychromy, joints and historically specific proportions are omitted.

presets.name: Voussoir arch and barrel vault
presets.summary: Repeated wedge-shaped arch rings extend into a short tunnel on two side supports.
limitations: Voussoir gaps are exaggerated for legibility; contact mechanics and centering are not simulated.
Abutment size and wall thickness are illustrative and have no verified load capacity.

presets.name: Dome with open oculus
presets.summary: A thick spherical shell and open crown sit on a partial drum, revealing interior and exterior form.
limitations: The drum has a deliberate display opening; this is not a structurally complete building.
Uniform shell thickness, material colours and proportions are invented; the model is not the Pantheon.

presets.name: Gothic rib-and-buttress bay
presets.summary: Pointed edge arches and diagonal ribs meet above four piers, with exterior flyers drawn as a teaching skeleton.
limitations: Vault webs and most walls are deliberately omitted; this is a rib skeleton, not a complete vault.
The flyers, joints and foundations are schematic; no structural analysis or site reconstruction is provided.

presets.name: Dravida-inspired vimana study
presets.summary: A square base, diminishing tiers and an abstract crown explore a southern Indian sanctum-tower silhouette.
limitations: Inspired by the Tamil Chola context described by UNESCO; not a universal Indian temple or a measured Chola monument.
A vimana study, not a gopuram gateway; sacred images, ritual layout, inscriptions and authentic proportional rules are omitted.

presets.name: Chinese timber-and-bracket bay
presets.summary: A timber frame with a deliberate roof cutaway exposes stacked bracket arms, bearing blocks, beams and purlins.
limitations: A generic Chinese timber/bracket principle study; not a dynasty-specific bay or a proxy for all East Asian building traditions.
Interlocking joinery, graded timber sections, detailed dougong typology, roof tiles and seismic behaviour are not represented.
The near roof covering is omitted for visibility; the covering and supporting assembly are incomplete.

presets.name: Courtyard and arcade study
presets.summary: Four repeated arcades define an open central court and a shaded edge zone.
limitations: Invented round-arch courtyard; not an Alhambra reconstruction or a universal Islamic courtyard type.
Ornament, adjoining rooms, environmental performance, water systems and site-specific social uses are omitted.

presets.name: Modern diagrid study
presets.summary: Repeated diagonal members, perimeter ties and thin floor plates explain a triangulated tower envelope.
limitations: An invented square tower; no dimensions or fabrication details are copied from Hearst Tower.
Joints, core interaction, fire protection, lateral drift, buckling and member capacity are unanalysed.

presets.name: Gridshell surface study
presets.summary: Crossing laths trace a shallow doubly curved canopy with a continuous perimeter edge.
limitations: A geometry study only; the quadrilateral lattice lacks a resolved bracing and connection design.
No forming simulation, timber bending limits, shell analysis or claim to reproduce the Savill Building.

presets.name: Double-layer space-frame study
presets.summary: Offset upper and lower grids connect through diagonals, making the depth of a three-dimensional truss visible.
limitations: Spheres and struts symbolize nodes and members; these are not a proprietary connection detail or fabrication model.
Support conditions, loads, buckling, tolerances and deflection are not checked.
